reviewer: Investigating agent, separate from author; claims bound to fresh kernel audit and read exact definitions/types
tool: Pinned Charon/Aeneas/Lean 4.35.0; frozen cargo-elicit 0.2 correspondence/exact-type checker

api_semantic_review.property: Successful return has natural field values (1,0), no extra precondition
Every representable u16 pair successfully encodes to 65536*b+a
Every u32 successfully decodes to low/high 16-bit halves
Every representable state and byte slice successfully matches scalar recurrence modulo 65521, including empty normalization
Successful scalar recurrence from (1,0), then arithmetic encoding

specification_review.state: Natural values of original u16 fields
specification_review.update: Fold step from normalized initial pair; explicit equivalence to normalized fold from original pair checked
specification_review.bounds: Only actual representable Rust argument/slice bounds, no artificial total length cap or normalized-seed assumption
specification_review.implementation_correspondence: Fresh adapter audit maps exact original bodies/spans, generated actual signature and native contracts; optimized helper loops covered by compute_spec
specification_review.lean_only_factoring: finish factors the generated suffix; its total theorem is applied to the actual suffix through checked definitional equality/WP monotonicity, not an assumed alternative Rust implementation

additional_laws.Proofs.split_update: Two original updates equal one combined update, with concatenated-slice representability
additional_laws.Proofs.save_restore_resume: Save/restore preserves subsequent original update for every state
additional_laws.Proofs.split_save_restore_resume: Split+save/restore equals combined original update, with concatenated-slice representability

limits: Semantic review is an explicit investigator judgment, not inferred from successful compilation
Compiler/extractor/translator/standard models and Lean kernel remain trusted
One authoring trial does not establish general performance or robustness
